/science: ScienceBeyond the surface. Into the biology.Technology is not the goal. Understanding you is.This page explains the science behind what we do. No jargon. Just the ideas that matter.Your birthday tells one story. Your cells tell another.Your chronological age is how many birthdays you’ve had. Your biological age is how old your body behaves. Two people born in the same year can age at very different speeds. Genes play a part. But so do food, sleep, stress and exercise. And many of those can be changed.Scientists have mapped 12 ways the body ages.In 2023, researchers listed twelve connected changes that happen as we age. They help us know where to look. Tap any one to learn more.01020304050607080910111201 / 12DNA damageYour DNA picks up wear and tear over timeLópez-Otín C. et al. Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe. Cell, 2023.How our tests work.LightLight can tell us about your cells. Our fingertip scanner shines light through your skin and takes more than 700,000 readings. It measures carotenoids: antioxidants from colourful fruit and vegetables that help protect your cells.BloodYour blood carries signals from every organ. One blood draw shows us how your metabolism, organs and cells are working.GenesYour genes don’t change. But knowing them helps you choose the food, exercise and sleep that suit your body best.Stem cells: your body’s repair team.Stem cells can turn into other types of cells. They help your body repair itself. They live in special spots called niches, such as your bone marrow. As we age, they become fewer and slower. That’s why DOX prepares your body first. And why CELLUTION uses your own cells.Your platelets, tiny cells in your blood, carry growth factors. These are signals that tell your body to start repairing. CELLUTION uses both: your own repair signals and your own repair cells.Each test has a specific job. No single result tells the whole story of your health.Biological ageing and biomarkersCellular biologyMetabolic healthNutrition and your genesAntioxidants and carotenoidsTelomeresSugars and ageing (glycobiology)Regenerative medicineRecovery and movement

/founder: FounderA vision shaped by science, and by people.Dr Praj Shendge · Founder & Scientific Director, BIOVITY · Founder, THOPMy journey into longevity started long before BIOVITY.I studied and worked in biotechnology, embryology, stem cells and regenerative medicine. I spent more than ten years doing this in the United Kingdom.Along the way, one question stayed with me.What if we looked at the whole person, instead of one part at a time?Science has come so far. We understand genes, cells and metabolism better than ever. But for patients, care still feels split up. Lots of tests. Lots of specialists. Very little that connects.I wanted to build something different. That became BIOVITY. And from BIOVITY came THOP, The Human Optimisation Protocol: five clear steps, from understanding your body to staying with you over time.I believe health should be about more than treating illness. It should be about understanding the biology that shapes your life. That’s what BIOVITY is here to do.Dr Praj Shendge · Founder & Scientific Director, BIOVITY
